about: Round 49, the master round: the hits’ curves, new light and dark themes, follow-ups, the band (dots, strands, a ribbon), the sky (stars, crescent, sunset).

drafts.name: Hits: the split a quarter stronger
drafts.line: You said the split could be “maybe a quarter stronger”. Only the split changes; shake and colour boost are as they are. Watch it play.

drafts.line: Today the shake starts at strength 0.6 (not 0.5) and reaches 24 px at 0.85; most hits are between 0.5 and 0.8. You suggested starting it a little later. Only the shake changes. Watch it play.

variants.note: Starts at 0.66, reaches 24 px at 0.91. A hit of 0.75 shakes 7 px.

drafts.name: Hits: strong shakes in quick succession
drafts.line: You said many strong hits close together make the picture harder to read. Here a shake is reduced when it follows a similar or larger one within a second: by half at half a second, never below a quarter. A hit on its own, or stronger than the ones before it, shakes as today.

drafts.name: Hits: the band lights
drafts.line: Last time the rule was unclear and you could not tell when it lit. Two simple rules: every bar takes the hot colour for as long as the hit lasts, on the strongest hits only, or on every hit that shakes. Watch it play.

drafts.name: New light themes: tinted papers
drafts.line: Stone, Linen, Sage and Sky came from a page like this. Six more, each a quiet tinted ground with dark bars of its own family and one warm note. Pick every version you would be happy to see in videos; “none” is an answer too.

variants.note: Pale blue-green, deep teal-green bars, a brick bar and sun.

drafts.name: New light themes: from painters, on quiet grounds
drafts.line: The page “from pictures” gave nothing: white grounds, loud bars. These take a painter’s colours onto the kind of ground you choose. One breaks the habit of a warm sun. Pick every version you would be happy to see in videos; “none” is an answer too.

drafts.name: New dark themes: more rooms
drafts.line: Four of the six rooms went in. Four more, with bars as light as the ones you chose and no red or pink ground. Pick every version you would be happy to see in videos; “none” is an answer too.

drafts.name: Pencil → ink on the inked light themes
drafts.line: On Stone you chose pencil → ink beside the whole course inked. The same change on the other light themes that are inked from the start. Pick the themes where it works; “none” is an answer too.

drafts.name: Dots on other themes
drafts.line: You liked the dots on Rothko and on Paper (“very neat, very clean”), not on White and Vermilion. Here on six more themes. Pick the themes where it works; “none” is an answer too.

drafts.name: Dots: lower, smaller
drafts.line: The dots have no reflection, so the band can sit a little lower; you suggested that for balance. Bars, then the dots three ways.

drafts.name: Strands, thinner
drafts.line: The strands were “too thick, too bold”, “not slick enough”. On Rothko: as last round, then one step and two steps thinner; all swing wider than before and sit a little lower. Then the middle weight on three other themes. Watch it play.

variants.note: Silver strands, the front one red, instead of navy and lavender.

drafts.name: A wave instead of strands
drafts.line: Another answer to “not slick enough”: no hairlines at all. The music’s contour is one filled wave in the bars’ colour, fading out downward, with its edge in the hot colour. Watch it play. Pick the themes where it works; “none” is an answer too.

drafts.line: You asked for the stars “a little bit thinner near the level where there’s a rider”. The moon alone, then three ways.

drafts.name: Starry Night again
drafts.line: You saw potential in Starry Night (ink blue, silver band, a pale gold crescent) but its strands were too thick. The same theme with other bands.

drafts.name: The sunset, with less at the bottom
drafts.line: You called the sunset “a good idea” but refused it each time: “too much stuff at the bottom right”, the bars over the disc. Here the half disc is smaller and on the left, and the band is the strands, so the sun sets behind a few lines and not behind a wall of bars. Pick the themes where it works; “none” is an answer too.
